St. Luke’s did not have a copy of the LaserSpecialist.com website content because it already had been deleted from the Internet hosting company that St. Luke’s used and Erickson had given Dr. Sanderson the backup disks. Therefore, St. Luke’s used an Internet archive called the “Waybaek Machine” to obtain the copy of the LaserSpecialist.com website that it filed with its copyright registration. 8
